text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We did it, Trainer! Thanks to you, 
I somehow managed to get through the 
Classic Season!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka-sho. Our activities with 
Meisho Doto were able to continue without 
a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The reason I'm able to do my best like 
this is thanks to you, Trainer... and to 
Opera O-san and Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The passion I put into racing... I can't 
hold a candle to the two of you, but it's 
about time I...
choice_data_list: How about... we set a big goal soon?
How about... we set a big goal soon?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, no, but, um, I wouldn't go that 
far...
choice_data_list:
Should I try making a bold declaration 
myself!?

Maybe I'll try making a bold declaration 
myself!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, going that far is impossible 
for me~! My heart would be pounding way 
too hard~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem to have enough courage to 
set a goal on her own just yet. It will 
take a little longer to blossom...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAANG!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a loud noise echoed through the 
trainer's office. Looking over, the door 
had been kicked wide open.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Doto! Did you hear that, 
Doto's Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san is... Ayabe-san is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble, whoosh!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: An inflammation... in my leg...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"You don't know... when I can return to 
racing...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes—that's what the doctor said.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka Sho—I had a feeling 
something was off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, it can't be... Ayabe-san is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody said a word. Not even T.M. Opera 
O. A heavy silence hung in the air."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
This is... just too much. Something like 
this shouldn't ever happen...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Because Ayabe-san is... Ayabe-sa... 
uuu..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I feel... like I've been forgiven, if only 
a little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to run for a while. If you 
can't run... you don't have to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to force yourself... to 
look up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-But... But stillll!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, what's done is done. Sometimes, you 
need to take a break.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Take care, Ayabe-san. Come now, I'm sure 
you'll be fine. And yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The battle against the previous 
generation... the Golden Generation, just 
got a whole lot tougher.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If either of the two titans is missing, 
I'll be thoroughly marked and boxed in."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O lamented the future. And at the 
very end—she quietly muttered.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this too is fate. Now that it's 
come to this, I suppose all we can do is 
wait."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, not Ayabe-san... And Opera O-san 
too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My... both of my... Uuu, waaahhhhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG! RAT-A-TAT-TAT-TAT!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Why, why, why why why?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Why would God do something like this? 
Ayabe-san is such a wonderful person...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(She did so many things for me. Opera 
O-san did, too. But...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can't do anything! I can't give anything 
back in return! Waaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the rain stopped, and I found 
Meisho Doto standing there all alone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: There you are, I was looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm clumsy, slow, sluggish, stupid... But 
even with this foolish head of mine, I 
thought as hard as I could.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And that made me realize: there's nothing 
I can do for Ayabe-san right now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And even a fool like me realized it. The 
things I took for granted... weren't 
guaranteed at all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, Ayabe-san... And not just 
Ayabe-san, but Opera O-san too. Yet 
there's nothing I can do..."
choice_data_list: Isn't there anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Isn't there... something we can do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a question uttered almost like a 
prayer. Words that slipped out casually. 
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing... I can do. Nothing at 
all... for Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it might not mean I can't do 
anything else at all.”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is going to break at this 
rate. If she breaks, the place Ayabe-san 
has to return to will...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's the one thing that must be 
protected. Absolutely, no matter what, at 
all costs, by someone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Someone who can run alongside Opera O-san. 
If there's no one who can do that—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —I will.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short phrase of only four letters. Yet 
it was the first time Meisho Doto had ever 
uttered words imbued with such fierce 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I am clumsy, slow, sluggish, and stupid. 
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm not ungrateful. I just, I just, I have 
to! I have to get stronger—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the way I am now isn't enough. Not 
in power, not in speed, not in anything. 
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: From the Big Races—On to the Spring GⅠs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, a lengthy discussion was held, 
and a conclusion was reached. Our target 
would be the GII Nikkei Shinshun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's an early-year race that leaves plenty 
of time for any G1 next year. Top 
Senior-class contenders will be competing, 
but even so—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm running! I'll run and show everyone my 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Losing its precious protection―― only 
then did the sprout break through the 
rock-hard earth."
